items.label: The Motherland Calls
items.note: Height includes the held sword; reported nominal sculpture height, rounded.

visual.attribution: AI-generated illustration, Cloudflare FLUX.2 Klein 4B, fixed 4 steps; text-only, not a photographic scan.

generation.prompt: Create a faithful photorealistic isolated rendering of the actual named monument, not a generic statue or a redesigned person. The Motherland Calls monument in Volgograd, Russia. A dynamic monumental gray concrete woman in a windblown classical robe, standing in a wide stride. Her RIGHT hand raises a long straight sword high above her head, her LEFT arm reaches outward with an open hand. Mouth open in a rallying call. Preserve the famous sweeping diagonal body pose, sword and flowing cape silhouette. Matte weathered pale gray concrete, not metallic, no shield. Include the complete sword tip and every finger and both feet. Straight-on near-orthographic front view at eye level, minimal perspective. The ENTIRE sculpted figure including every extremity must fit in the image with 12 percent clear white margin on every side; keep the subject to at most 76 percent of image height and width. Plain uniform pure white background. Soft even neutral studio light. No pedestal, no display plinth, no floor plane, no cast shadow, no scenery, no people, no added text, labels, watermark or frame.
